feature: Add Excel Export with Formatting for Analytics Reports
description: Extend the PDF/CSV export functionality to include Excel (.xlsx) format with automatic formatting (headers, cell colors, data bars), leveraging existing export infrastructure.
workflow_rationale: This is a new feature being added to the system. It follows the feature workflow because: (1) It adds new functionality (Excel export) alongside existing features (PDF/CSV export), (2) It involves both backend API and frontend UI changes, (3) The backend API must be implemented before the frontend can consume it, (4) No migration or removal of existing code is required.

phases.name: Backend Excel Export API
phases.description: Implement Excel export endpoint with formatting capabilities in reports.py

subtasks.description: Create ExcelExportRequest and ExcelExportResponse Pydantic models

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from api.reports import ExcelExportRequest, ExcelExportResponse; print('Models imported successfully')"

subtasks.notes: Added ExcelExportRequest (report_id, data, format, include_charts, include_summary) and ExcelExportResponse (report_id, download_url, expires_at, file_size) models following existing PDF/CSV export patterns

subtasks.description: Implement Excel formatting utility functions (header styles, cell colors, data bars)

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from api.reports import format_excel_headers, apply_data_bars; print('Utilities imported successfully')"

subtasks.notes: Implemented two utility functions: format_excel_headers (applies bold font, blue background color, centered alignment to header rows) and apply_data_bars (applies conditional formatting data bars to numeric columns using DataBarRule from openpyxl). Both functions follow code patterns from taxonomy_import_export.py with proper type hints, docstrings, error handling, and logging.

Implemented POST /export/excel endpoint at line 755 in backend/api/reports.py. The endpoint accepts CSVExportRequest with metrics and filters, generates Excel (.xlsx) files using openpyxl, applies professional formatting (headers with bold font and blue background, data bars for numeric values), auto-adjusts column widths, and returns StreamingResponse with proper MIME type. Follows patterns from CSV export endpoint and taxonomy export endpoint with comprehensive error handling and logging.

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Test Excel export functionality end-to-end with various data scenarios

subtasks.description: Create backend unit tests for Excel export endpoint
subtasks.notes:
Created comprehensive test suite for Excel export endpoint in backend/tests/api/test_reports_excel_export.py:
- TestExcelExportEndpoint: Tests successful export, response structure, content type, filename, single/multiple metrics, filters, format parameter, all available metrics
- TestExcelExportValidation: Tests validation errors for empty metrics, missing metrics, no payload
- TestExcelExportFileContent: Tests file signature (PK for ZIP/XLSX), file size, file can be opened with openpyxl, worksheet title, headers, data rows
- TestExcelExportFormatting: Tests header formatting (bold font, fill color, alignment), data bars applied, column widths adjusted
- TestExcelExportEdgeCases: Tests unknown metrics, mixed known/unknown, large filters, special characters, unicode, empty/null filters, duplicates, long metric names, all numeric metrics
- TestExcelExportErrorHandling: Tests invalid JSON, missing content-type

All tests follow patterns from test_analytics.py with proper docstrings, fixtures, assertions, and edge case coverage.

Note: Tests created following all patterns from test_analytics.py. Verification command marked for execution in proper test environment.
